start.title: Welcome to Our Futures First
start.body:
Our Futures First is a student-run open letter on how AI is developed, written by people at U.S. universities. This server is where campus organizers work together before launch day.

**To get in:** press **Find my campus**, type your university email and a few lines about yourself. We email you a 6-digit code (look in Junk too), you press **Enter my code** and type it in, and you land in a private chat with everyone else from your university. Your introduction is posted in #introductions and in your campus chat.

Your email is only used to work out your university. It is never shown in the server. The organizing team sees it only if you ask them to add you by hand.

guide:
**What organizers do**

1. **Meet your campus.** Your university has its own private chat here, and your introduction is posted there when you join.
2. **Bring people in.** Your personal link is on {site}. Send it to people at your university: friends, classmates, clubs, professors.
3. **Shape the letter.** The draft changes as answers come in. Tell us in the server what should change.
4. **Be ready for launch day.** Everyone is contacted at once to sign and share. Watch {announcements} for the date.
codeSent:
We emailed a 6-digit code to **{email}** ({uni}), from contact@ourfuturesfirst.org.

**Check your Junk or Spam folder too.** University mail filters often put it there. The code works for an hour.
noCodeHelp:
**No code?** First look in Junk or Spam for an email from contact@ourfuturesfirst.org. It can take a few minutes.

Still nothing? The organizing team can let you in by hand. They will see the email address you typed, so they can check it is yours.
requested:
Asked. An organizer will look at your request for **{uni}**, and you will be pinged in your campus chat when you are in. There is nothing more to do.

If the code turns up first, press **Enter my code**.
requestedAgain: Your request for **{uni}** is already with the organizers. You will be pinged in your campus chat when you are in.
request:
{team} **Join request** from {user} (`{name}`): their code never arrived.
Email they typed: `{email}`
University: **{uni}**

Approve only if you are sure this address is theirs. Approving skips the email check and puts them in the {uni} chat.
requestHeld: **Careful:** this address is already confirmed by {other}. Approving moves it to this account and takes {other} out of the {uni} chat.
approvedAlready: **Already in:** their code arrived in the meantime. (Checked by {by}.)
approvedStuck: **Approved** by {by}, but the bot could not finish placing them. Give them their roles by hand.
requestGone: This request was already handled, or replaced by a newer one.
teamOnly: Only the core team can approve or decline requests.
declinedDm: An organizer could not confirm the email you typed in the Our Futures First server, so you were not added. If that is a mistake, write to contact@ourfuturesfirst.org.
placed:
You're in{name}. Your campus chat is {campus}: **{uni}**, {people} so far.

**First things to do**
1. Your introduction is up in {introductions} and {campus}. Say hi to the others there.
2. Send your personal link from {site} to a few people at {uni}.
3. Keep an eye on {announcements} for launch day.
notSigned: One thing: we could not find a confirmed sign-up for this email. Add your voice at {site} so you are counted.
campusFirst: {user} is the first one here from **{uni}**. Everyone who joins from {uni} lands in this channel.
campusJoined: {user} just joined from **{uni}**. That makes {count} of you here.
campusTopic: Organizers at {uni}. Private to people who confirmed a {uni} email.

errors.bad_email: That does not look like an email address. Try again with your university email.
errors.not_university: We could not match that address to a U.S. university. Use your university (.edu) email, or write to contact@ourfuturesfirst.org.
errors.slow_down: Too many codes were asked for just now. Wait an hour and try again, or write to contact@ourfuturesfirst.org.
errors.mail_off: We cannot send codes right now. Press **Ask the organizers** and one of them will add you by hand. They will see the email address you typed.
errors.no_code: There is no code waiting for you. Press **Find my campus** to get one.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Press **Find my campus** to get a new one.
errors.too_many_tries: Too many wrong tries. Press **Find my campus** to get a new code.
errors.wrong_code: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
errors.declined: An organizer looked at your request and could not confirm that address. If that is a mistake, write to contact@ourfuturesfirst.org.
errors.busy: The organizers have a lot of requests right now. Try again in an hour.
errors.full: You are confirmed for **{uni}**, but the server has run out of room for new campus channels. An organizer will add yours by hand.
errors.other: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute, or write to contact@ourfuturesfirst.org.
errors.short_intro: Write a little more in your introduction: a sentence or two about who you are and why you want to help.

introPlaceholder: Who you are, what you study or work on, and why you want to help. A few sentences is plenty. Everyone in the server will see this.
